capabilities.assessment: Generation identity primitives exist (document UUID5 scope+source+pipeline, run UUID5 document+job:attempt, manifest, job/attempt) but a coexisting same-source generation cannot be admitted: live unique index uq_library_documents_scope_collection_sha256 (knowledge_scope_id, collection_id, source_sha256) rejects a second physical document row. Coexistence inside one document row is not implemented either.

Document/run/job/attempt/manifest identity exists and is attributable, but there is no explicit generation identity that separates two generations of the same logical source inside the retrieval model; chunk_set_version is hardcoded to 1 and retrieval does not gate on it.

No active-run column, no active_generation column, no superseded_by. 'Current C' is an observed state (one ready document + one completed run), not a stored invariant; unknown active identity cannot be resolved fail-closed.

content_manager.publish_document activates a candidate only; no operation deactivates the previous generation and no atomic reverse pair exists. Status-based isolation is false: text_search has no status filter and hybrid_search filters by scope only.

Rows, chunks, embeddings and vectors can physically coexist and archived status exists, but no retention/ownership hold prevents generic cleanup from touching a retained generation, and the cleanup/publication race is still open.

Retained OLD could be reactivated without reembedding, but the reverse operation does not exist and the page-publication route resolves the newest completed run, so a reverse switch would not restore the published page view of OLD.

Atomic hash-checked preservation and a source API exist for the new worker (durable_source.preserve_source, gateway usage), and the external original matches the approved SHA with 284 pages, but OLD has source_path=NULL, source_uri=NULL and no deterministic durable file; storage retention/backup/viewer access are unproven.

FULL/PARTIAL/UNUSABLE page aggregate and per-region ACCEPTED/QUARANTINED publication metadata (region-publication-v1) are produced by the regional pipeline and persisted in page layout_notes. OLD C carries none (legacy unclassified extraction).

Chunks are document-owned with no run FK and no generation column; chunk_set_version is constant 1. The new INSERT-collision guard refuses to adopt preexisting resources (safe failure) but no generation discriminator exists to hold OLD and NEW chunks apart in the same document.

Vector PK is derived from chunk identity and document_id is present as metadata, so a PG-selected active document set is filterable, but primary vectors carry no run/attempt/generation field and the normal vector query filters by scope only. PG hydration now drops unauthorizable or misattributed hits, which is a defensive improvement, not isolation.

text_search.py has no document-status predicate; hybrid_search.py filters by scope only; simple_research_repository.py allows 'ready' plus opt-in 'test_candidate'; relation_qa_repository.py filters by status allow-list. No route shares one active-generation predicate, so an ingested-but-inactive candidate is retrievable on at least the lexical path.

source_repository.get_page_publication selects the newest completed run of a document (ORDER BY r.finished_at DESC LIMIT 1). A candidate run that completes before cutover therefore replaces OLD's published region metadata.

Citations resolve through document_id + chunk_id + editorial entity, and evidence ids v2 are chunk/entity derived, so they legitimately change between generations; no generation discriminator is carried into citation metadata and lineage retention is not implemented.
Ordinary upload returns EXACT_DUPLICATE and no authorized path exists to admit a second generation of the same approved source. The live uniqueness index also rejects the physical insert.

Deterministic ids, upserts and manifests exist; a new INSERT-collision guard aborts instead of adopting preexisting resources and cleanup refuses already-ready/archived documents, but manifest ownership does not prove preexisting-resource ownership, cleanup has no shared publication lock, and interrupted candidates are not certified invisible or cleanup-safe.

Pure extract_pdf_region_published / publish_certified_page exist and run in memory, but the worker pipeline persists pages/chunks and dispatches embeddings, so no safe end-to-end dry-run switch exists. No full-C dry-run was performed in this planning gate.
No tool emits region/page/document reconciliation for OLD vs NEW, and no A/B/C query fixture set is sealed. The contract exists only as a design in this report.
No compare-and-swap over an active generation identity, no visibility epoch, no reader epoch pinning, no audited reverse primitive. A partially applied switch is observable today.
